notes.title: Build 7.3.27.4 is now live
notes.content:
This is a small update to get Jetball development back up and running.


 Fixed fire bind not unbinding the old key
 Fixed animation rotations, e.g., doing a vgh (for hi), now waves at the target instead of off to the side slightly. Animation rotations also now work up and down so you can wave at someone above or below you.
 Fixed the slide effect on ExoRed model

notes.title: Build 0.7.3.27.3 is now live
notes.content:
Restored dedicated servers (Windows and Linux servers are both confirmed to be working again)
 Restored Mac version
 Fixed switching weapons bug
 Fixed several visual issues (menu, vchat, etc)
 Stats are working again (stats only record from a dedicated server)

This is a rollback from Unreal Engine 5.3 back to Unreal Engine 4.27. Unfortunately, the latest Unreal Engine 5 is too unstable to use in production. I may consider updating it once a stable version is released.

notes.title: Build 0.7.5.2.1 is now live
notes.content:
- Updated to Unreal Engine 5.2.1 (latest stable).
- Performance fix on the bounds grid (should improve FPS on all maps).
- WASD is now the default key mapping for new players (can easily swap between WASD and ESDF in the binds menu).
- Slight improvement to bots when catching balls that might go over their head (still WIP).
- Bots are slightly less annoying with their targeting lasers.
- Doubled the projectile speed on the spike gun.
- Fixed the glitchy slide walls on the training map (the big slide found in the volcano area).

Known Issues
- Dedicated servers are temporarily broken (both Windows and Linux). This appears to be related to Unreal Engine 5.2 (a fix is slated for 5.4). Hosting in game works fine and you no longer need to open any ports when hosting in game.
- VChat menu has minor drawing issues.

notes.title: Build 0.7.2.25.3 is live
notes.content:
Build 0.7.2.25.3 is now live (cumulative build notes)
Features:

 Server list now shows active player count and map name
 New Menu background with bots playing an infinite game length in the background
 Menu now plays four music tracks in rotation
 Bots now slide ski (as opposed to jump ski)
 Added very slight air control (most modern games have this; expected by new players)
 Unreal Engine Update 4.25.3


Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug where high end machines would desync with the server creating jarring movement
 Fixed the VChat menu breaking after returning to the menu
 Fixed the beacon jump not executing (rare case for very low ping players)
 Fixed grass flashing when the ball is flashing
 Ball arrow indicator remains at closer distance (KOE request)
 Fixed (normalized) weapon fire/switching audio
 Fixed input simulation on networked clients where other players looked a bit janky before and some players would keep moving (i.e. running then snapping back)
 Beacon stop/jump sounds play according to speed (faster = louder)
 Fall damage adjusted to increase exponentially.  Now take less damage at normal speeds, but die quicker at super high speeds.  (TT request)

notes.title: Build 0.7.1.24.3 is now live
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30619347/f52512dfe25b978a1f395f8798921f2dcc8f4ce9.png
Features:
- New slide ability - gain momentum sliding down hills - carve to adjust direction (and of course you can still jump ski too)
- New slide effect that kicks up sparks and dust at your feet while sliding
- New throw and slap animations (players holding throw visibly have their hands "cocked" behind their heads)
- New vchat animations (emotes)
- New grass that bends at player's feet
- New map "Playdium"
- New weapon reticles
- Added a disc launcher muzzle fire effect
- Added a bullet "whizzing" sound
- Unreal Engine Update 4.24.3 (latest stable)

Bug Fixes
- Fixed muzzle fire not showing for others in multiplayer
- Fixed spike gun reload and continue to fire bug in MP
- Holding zoom now adjusts for mouse sensitivity (mouse became overly sensitive before)
- Fixed a walking bug where you walked faster uphill (nobody noticed cause nobody walks in Jetball)!
- Much improved projectile replication (jitter is rare now).
- Restored demo playback / recordings and made various improvements like pausing with mouse wheel
- Server waits for player connections (newly joined game should start from countdown)

notes.title: Build 0.6.1.22.2 is now live
notes.content:
Features:
	- Major Technical Update
	- Steam Integration
		- Invite Steam friends to your game
		- Easily host your own game server (no more opening ports)
		- Server browser should now find all games (Lan, Internet, Dedicated)
		- Server browser now shows Ping times
	- Unreal Engine Updated 4.22 (latest)
		- Converted to the Network Replication Graph Technology (100 player support?)	
	- Bots generate more one-timer goals (often scoring over 100 points in an all bot 3v3 match).
	- (Bots still have weapons disabled)
	
Bug Fixes:
	- Dedicated Servers Restored (note hosting your own dedicated server requires opening ports 27015 and 7777).

notes.title: Build 0.5.8.19.2 is now live
notes.content:

	- Improved bot passing and shooting accuracy.
	- Improved bot jet control for catching and intercepting the ball.
	- Bots will almost always look for a one-timer play (rather than straight throw in).
	- Play with a single bot on the same team to work on your one-timer goals.
	- (Bots still have their weapons disabled)
	
Gameplay Changes:
	- None. 

Bug Fixes:
	- 2K Menu and UI support
	- Moved to new dedicated server host.

notes.title: Build 0.5.0.18.2 is now live
notes.content:
Features:
Completely re-worked how the keybinds are handled.
Added default binds for WASD and ESDF players.
Menus cleaned up and improved to support lower resolutions.
Fixed a missing sound with the disc launcher (fire effect volume was so low it was inaudible).
Beacon and Springboard sound effect volumes adjusted to reflect player speed.
Updated to Unreal Engine 4.18.2.
Gameplay Changes:
Bots should no longer get stuck in the spawn huts.
Bug Fixes:
See keybind feature (controllers still need more work but are supported).
Score hud fixed for lower resolutions
Start up intro loud volume fixed.
Adjusted jetpack for Alpha and Vangaurd (and some animation improvements)
Fixed a crash when running a lot of bots on a server.
Known Issues:
Some character animations are not working at the right time (like walking instead of skiing or vice versa).
Some character jetpack locations are not aligned yet.
Slapping the ball quickly between players causes a multiverse infinite possibilites scenerio with some interesting results.
The brake key has been known to stick for at least one player (hitting brake again fixes it).
After changing teams, players can see both team messaging waypoints indicators (when you should only see your own team message waypoints).
The mouse goes inverted sometimes when playing with sensitivity - workaround is to check the invert mouse box (until you restart then it will correct itself requiring you to unchkeck the box).

notes.title: H-O-R-S-E Season 0 and Draft Tournament
notes.content:
We are very excited to announce Season 0 of Jetball HORSE! This will be a casual weekly community challenge that everybody can participate in, on their own time. The basic premise is below, more details will follow:

A specific trick shot will be assigned every week. Players have 1 week to submit a gif of them completing the challenge
If a player fails to submit a clip of the trick shot, they will get a letter (H-O-R-S-E)
The first player to submit a successful shot gets to invent next week's trick shot (pending admin approval)
The last player who is not a HORSE wins
Of course, fabulous prizes await the winner, and all participants will be rewarded

For our first week I will introduce the challenge now to provide some extra time. We expect to officially kick this off midweek.

Map: Epic City
Shot: Bounce off enemy wall, off ground, into thine own goal
GIF here

[video]https://giant.gfycat.com/BaggyGenuineAfricanbushviper.webm[/video]

Also, Juke is hosting a Ho-Ho Holiday Slapdown Draft Tournament. Tentative date of December 29,  sign-ups are here.
Take a break from the craziness of the holidays and slap some balls across the sky. All experience levels are welcome.

As always, join us in Discordfor more information

notes.title: Build 0.4.3.18.1 Hotfix is now live
notes.content:
Buca's goal is weekly updates but lots of great feedback and bugs are popping up with the influx of new players so he wanted to start addressing some of these right away.

Features:
    - Multiplied the aim sensitivity range by 4 as there was not enough range for controllers and also low end mice (your saved sensitivity will likely be effected).

Gameplay Changes:
    - None

Bug Fixes:
    - Removed a loud horn sound that occurred for some players when hosting a local game.
    - Attempted to fix a mouse issue where the mouse would leave the game window (fix unconfirmed).
    - Fixed the "coundown" spelling error during the match countdown.

Known Issues:
    - First time running the game there is often a problem where available keybinds and screen resolutions do not appear correctly - restart the game to fix.
    - The keybind screen is little wonky at times (order moves around by itself) but seems to get the job done.
    - Chat box has an issue after your first message. Clicking between each chat message seems to clear it up
    - Some character animations are not working at the right time (like walking instead of skiing or vice versa).
    - Some character jetpack locations are not aligned yet.
    - Slapping the ball quickly between players causes a multiverse infinite possibilites scenerio with some interesting results.
    - The brake key has been known to stick for at least one player (hitting brake again fixes it).
    - After changing teams, players can see both team messaging waypoints indicators (when you should only see your own team message waypoints).
    - The mouse goes inverted sometimes when playing with sensitivity - workaround is to check the invert mouse box (until you restart then it will correct itself requiring you to unchkeck the box)
